name: projection-update
body: The behaviour that applies a `projection-delta` to the live `db.lbug` in place: delete exactly the FQNs/edges the mutation removed (by identity — no `<project>/` prefix assumption), merge exactly the records it added or updated, in one transaction, and roll back on failure. Serves both the durable node/edge path and the transient plan/feedback path, so no metadata mutation needs a code re-scan.
